title: Webhooks
description: HTTP endpoints for inbound LLM invocations and channel-message delivery.
emptyDescription: Create a webhook to expose an HMAC-signed endpoint.

kindHint.llm: Invokes an agent. Returns the response synchronously (≤30s) or queues an async delivery with a callback_url.
kindHint.message: Delivers a payload to a bound channel (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, ...). Requires a channel.

form.title: Create webhook
form.description: The secret is shown only once after creation.
form.name: Name
form.agentIdPlaceholder: UUID — bind this webhook to a specific agent
form.requireHmacHint: Reject requests without a valid X-Webhook-Signature header.

secret.hmacHint: For HMAC-signed requests, replace the Authorization header with X-Webhook-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac_sha256_hex(t + . + body, key)>

created.title: Webhook created
created.description: Copy the secret now — it will not be shown again.

rotated.title: Secret rotated
rotated.description: The previous secret stopped working immediately. Copy the new one now.

rotate.title: Rotate secret
rotate.description: Rotating will invalidate the current secret immediately. Any client using it will start failing.

revoke.title: Revoke webhook
revoke.description: Revoke "{{name}}"? The secret stops working immediately, but the audit record is kept. You can permanently delete a revoked webhook afterwards.

delete.title: Permanently delete webhook
delete.description: Delete "{{name}}"? This removes the webhook and ALL of its delivery history. This cannot be undone.
